Name: Daniel Grunér
Description: During my time at Crosskey, Daniel was both a close colleague and my manager. Together, we discovered countless effective and innovative solutions to complex problems, ensuring that our diverse clientele remained satisfied. Beyond work, we also shared a few training sessions at the gym, which further strengthened our professional relationship and collaboration.

Name: Pekko Lindblom
Description: Project manager and teacher at Metropolia University of Applied Sciences, Pekko oversaw the SAM project, which I focused on for my engineering thesis. Impressed by the quality of my work, Pekko made the decision to hire me immediately after I completed my thesis. I was the only student from the project team offered a continuation contract, which I worked on for several months after graduation.

Name: Jukka Soinila
Description: CEO and founder of Net Get Games (formerly Tutanet Oy), Jukka was the boss during one of my first jobs as a game developer. He often expressed appreciation for my ability to create new systems from scratch and integrate them smoothly into the existing product.
